title: Supabase header
description: A 65px sticky bar, 90% opaque with a light blur and a hairline below: wordmark, six 15px ink nav items (three with chevrons that open small hover menus), and on the right a quiet counter link, a small white Sign-in button and a small green CTA, which fade in on load. Nav items turn green on hover and their chevrons flip. Phones get the wordmark and a menu icon that opens a full-screen list.
notes: position: sticky, so it stays in the page flow and pins at the top
dropdowns and the phone menu are CSS only (hover/focus and a details element)
the right-hand group's fade-in is a CSS keyframe, off with reduced motion
name: supabase-header

props.name: counter
props.description: a quiet counter link before the buttons, e.g. a repository's stars (icon + figure)

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label of the phone menu button
